title: Stockholders' equity rollforward — Talbot Inc.
instructions: Prepare Talbot Inc.'s December 31, 2025 equity balances. Talbot uses the cost method for treasury stock and applies stock dividends to shares outstanding.

exhibits.title: January 1, 2025 balances
exhibits.content:
| Account | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Common stock, $1 par (500,000 shares issued and outstanding) | 500,000 |
| Additional paid-in capital | 4,500,000 |
| Retained earnings | 3,000,000 |

exhibits.title: 2025 transactions, in order
exhibits.content:
1. Issued **50,000** shares for **$25** each.
2. Bought **10,000** shares of treasury stock for **$28** each.
3. Reissued **4,000** treasury shares for **$30** each.
4. Declared and distributed a **10%** stock dividend when the market price was **$30**.
5. Declared and paid a cash dividend of **$0.50** per outstanding share.
6. Net income: **$900,000**.
